children: Meta launched Muse AI on Sept 8; within weeks it topped App Store, exceeded ~3.4M downloads, integrated with 2,000+ apps and expanded to smartglasses and a pocket Muse device, boosting shares.
TD Cowen forecasts Meta Platforms (META) Muse headset revenue rising from $55M this year to $1.8B by 2027 and $27B by 2031 — highlighted as Meta's clearest non-core AI revenue stream
META spent about $72B on AI infrastructure and data centers last year; it may nearly double capex in 2026. Debt has risen, free cash flow fell, and buybacks are paused.
Canaccord Genuity raised Meta Platforms (META) price target to $950 from $930, citing Muse’s subscription and usage-fee monetization potential and low fees designed to attract developers and users.
META rallied as investor interest in Muse and strong free cash flow support AI spending from operations, reducing reliance on debt amid a higher-for-longer rate outlook.
Meta (META) rolled out Muse, an AI personal agent, at Connect. CEO Zuckerberg says millions have adopted it, but broad consumer uptake and monetization timelines remain uncertain.
Meta disclosed a Muse AI security flaw allowing access to users' dedicated VMs with emails and files. Issue reported via bug bounty, labeled SEV-2; Meta updated Muse in-app safety notices.
Meta Platforms (META) reaches 3.6 billion daily users via its ad platform, supporting ongoing ad revenue growth and further monetization opportunities.
Meta Platforms (META) gets ~98% of revenue from ads. A proposed small transaction fee on Muse would require massive user transactions to produce meaningful revenue for the company.
Morgan Stanley says Meta's Muse AI likely has limited impact on cable and telecom billing and subscription management; investor expectations may have been overstated, per firm’s revised assessment.
